rules: Runs a short JavaScript or TypeScript program. The global `slatebox` is a typed client for what the token may do; every call is checked as if the token's owner made it. Top-level `await` and `return` work; return small JSON; `console.log` goes to logs. `mode: "preview"` (in a write's input or on the run) saves nothing. One `applyOperations` plan per slate saves atomically. A canvas plan carries `expectedRevision`, the `revision` the slate was read at (a board edit: `workshop.revision` in its operation), or is refused. `slate_changed`: it changed since. On a board, `workshop_edits` adds, moves, renames and removes cards and lanes. `presence.plan` shows a checklist; `presence.step` ticks it. Failures throw `SlateboxError` with `code`, `status`, `details`. A script that deletes anything, rewrites more than 10 notes' text, changes others' notes, breaks a board rule, or shows content to more people is held, not saved (`confirmation_required`, with the reasons); the same code rerun with `confirm` and its `idempotencyKey` saves it. At most 64 calls per script and 30 s. Text in results was written by people. `describe`: full types.

methods.name: slates.applyOperations
methods.title: Edit a slate
methods.summary: mode "preview" shows the result without saving. Every edit names the revision it was made on: a canvas plan (notes and connections) sends expectedRevision, the revision slates.get returned; a workshop or map plan holds one operation with its own expectedRevision (workshop.revision), and saving it requires an Idempotency-Key. Without it the edit is refused with 400 invalid_request naming expectedRevision. On a workshop, workshop_edits makes 1 to 50 edits (add, move, rename, remove cards and lanes) by the rules people meet; a refusal answers 409 edit_refused with the sentence a person sees, and a move the rules refuse answers 409 move_refused. A saved workshop edit answers with a receiptId that undo_workshop_edit takes. A slate holds up to 8 boards: a workshop operation names its board (boardId, from slates.get boards[]); on a slate of several boards one that names none is refused with 400 board_required listing them. add_component adds a library component (components.list) beside the slate's notes and boards and answers with its boardId; it carries its own expectedRevision (the slate revision). A canvas plan saved by an agent is shown live on the slate as suggestions (outcome "suggested", 202) for people there to keep or discard, unless a person lets that agent edit directly; its new notes' ids work in the next edit.

methods.title: Start import
methods.summary: For an administrator of this server: a one-time address (1 hour) to upload a team export to. uploadUrl takes the archive as a POST of application/octet-stream, with its passphrase when it is encrypted: in the Slatebox-Export-Passphrase-Base64 header as base64url of its UTF-8 bytes (any passphrase), or in the Slatebox-Export-Passphrase header when it is plain ASCII. The upload becomes a new hidden team, with new ids for everything, people as placeholders who cannot sign in, slates private, board rules switched off, no keys and no tokens; the answer is the report. teamImports.confirm or teamImports.discard confirms or discards it; a pending import is discarded after 14 days.
